reviews.text: We've had our Bichon for several months now and we're very happy with the service; he always comes back well-groomed and clean. There's no doubt he's the best groomer in the neighborhood!
I've taken my dog ​​to get bathed several times. The service is always excellent and the staff is very friendly.
Annie provided excellent service!! I took my Dachshund for a bath and haircut (stripping) and he looked amazing!!! ♥️
The hairdresser provides amazing service ✅✅✅✅

Yesterday I took my dogs to Westie Blvd for the first time for a bath and haircut, and I was absolutely delighted. A very gentle and kind woman attended to them; you could see the care and empathy she showed the animals from the very first moment.

It's essential for me that they don't rush, and she took all the time necessary to ensure my dogs were relaxed and well cared for. It's clear she knows a great deal about grooming and technique, which gave me a lot of peace of mind.

In addition, the salon is spotless, very bright and clean, which made me feel completely confident leaving them in her care. As someone who lives here and is looking for truly trustworthy places for my dogs, I highly recommend it. Everything went perfectly!

We loved the place and Ani's way with pets. She's very kind, patient, and answered all our questions and requests attentively. We took our 4-month-old Westie puppy for a stripping and were very happy with the result.

Annie is very nice, she listens and respects your opinion. She does what you ask and doesn't do anything you don't want. She's professional and knows what she's doing. She looks after the dogs' well-being. She treats them very sweetly and respectfully. The price is similar to other places that aren't as good as this one.
A wonderful experience. I'm delighted, and so is my furry friend! I highly recommend it. I came from far away, but I'll be back!
Very happy with the service and how beautiful my wirehaired dachshund Lana looks. We'll be back!

The best

I've been taking my dog ​​Matilda to this groomer since she was a puppy. When she was three months old, she fell in a puddle and got covered in dirt up to her ears, and ever since then, we go religiously whenever she needs a bath and grooming.

Anahí is an excellent professional, very sweet, and she loves dogs. In fact, Matilda is so happy every time we go to the salon and adores her, which is essential for me.

My dog ​​has black nails, and I've always been afraid to cut them myself or take her somewhere where she might get hurt. Anahí has ​​NEVER damaged my dog's nails, and she does it with such care and gentleness that Matilda doesn't suffer at all.

In short, I think the price is perfect, even economical, because I truly believe that taking your pet to this salon isn't just about the bath; it's also about them enjoying all the care they need.

It's also worth mentioning that the products they use are all-natural and of the highest quality.

10/10 I wouldn't take Matilda anywhere else.

The best pet grooming service in Barcelona by far!

FANTASTIC GROOMER! My pom, Pancho, is total brat and refuses to let me or anyone else brush him, let alone groom him. I was terrified he would always look like a little hobo because I couldn't get this high-maintenance divo under control for long enough to even bathe him. She spent hours carefully de-matting and de-tangling my tiny monster after weeks of my failed brushing attempts. She then followed up with most perfect little haircut and handed me back a sweet-smelling, darling little devil! Thank you so, so much for your kindness and patience with Pancho AND me! We'll be customers for life!

I recommend this salon to all animal lovers.
